keywords: EIP-1 重新定义 meta EIP
summary: 周日较安静。Magicians 上 ERC-8301 AI 代理执行的讨论帖热度很高，它定义链上 AI 代理任务分派的三个最小接口。collinsadi 发布隐身地址名称解析草案，让 ENS 名称解析到 ERC-6538 的隐身元地址，并支持跨链只读镜像。

items.title: Magicians：隐身名称解析草案，跨异步链的隐身元地址名称
items.note: 03:54（collinsadi）。以太坊上的规范注册表同时充当某个父 ENS 名称的注册器和 ENSIP-10 通配解析器，提供 `com.opaque.meta` 文本记录；注册表可直接存储密钥，也可实时从 ERC-6538 注册表读取。草案还定义与传输方式无关的镜像载荷，让另一条链维护只读名称记录，而无需查询以太坊 RPC。
items.title_en: Magicians: draft proposal for Stealth Name Resolution, stealth meta-address names across asynchronous chains
items.note_en: 03:54 (collinsadi). A canonical Ethereum registry acts as both registrar and ENSIP-10 wildcard resolver for a parent ENS name, serving a `com.opaque.meta` text record; it can store keys directly or source them live from the ERC-6538 registry. The draft also defines a transport-agnostic mirror payload so a second chain can keep read-only name records without querying an Ethereum RPC.

items.title: Magicians：ERC-8301 AI 代理执行
items.note: 02:34（JimmyShi22），定义 `AgentTask`、`IAgentCaller`、`IAgentHandler` 三个最小接口，以及从单个代理调用扩展到分布式多轮共识的可组合工作流模型。
items.note_en: 02:34 (JimmyShi22), defining three minimal interfaces, `AgentTask`, `IAgentCaller` and `IAgentHandler`, plus a composable workflow model that scales from a single agent call to distributed multi-round consensus.

summary_en: A quiet Sunday. The Magicians thread for ERC-8301 AI Agent Execution drew a lot of attention; it defines three minimal interfaces for onchain AI agent task dispatch. collinsadi published a draft for stealth name resolution, letting ENS names resolve to ERC-6538 stealth meta-addresses with read-only mirrors on other chains.
